scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/db && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/db && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w apps/web && node api/build.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
